UnitStatement: GET handler for harness session [id] route resolves a non-empty session id, fetches it via runtime.sessionManager.getById, and returns { session } with HTTP 200.
DELETE handler for harness session [id] route validates the id and calls runtime.sessionManager.delete, returning { ok: true } with HTTP 200.
Both [id] route handlers wrap logic in try/catch and convert thrown errors to a response via errorResponse(error).
RouteContext type for the [id] route declares params: { id: string }, the dynamic route segment.
POST /api/harness/session/boot reads a SessionBootRequest body and requires a non-empty sessionId.
Boot resumes the session via sessionManager.resume(sessionId), then asserts the session's projectRoot is accessible via assertProjectRootAccessible.
Boot resolves runtime options from the session and request opts using resolveRuntimeOptions, then builds the persona system prompt via personaManager.buildSystemPrompt(projectRoot, persona, mode).
Boot computes a bootFingerprint via personaManager.getBootFingerprint(persona, mode).
Boot iterates agentSdkManager.startTurn(session,'bootstrap',resolvedOpts); on session:init it captures engineSessionId/claudeSessionId from event data.
Boot throws HarnessError('SDK_FAILURE',500,...) if a process:exit event reports a non-zero exitCode.
Boot persists engineSessionId, claudeSessionId, bootFingerprint, bootedAt (ISO timestamp), and model via sessionManager.save, returning the updated session plus a boot summary.
engineSessionId defaults to session.engineSessionId ?? session.claudeSessionId before the bootstrap turn runs.
POST /api/harness/session/create reads a SessionCreateRequest, requires a non-empty projectRoot, and creates a session via sessionManager.create({projectRoot,persona,mode}), returning { session }.
GET /api/harness/session/list requires a non-empty projectRoot query param and returns { sessions } from sessionManager.list(projectRoot).
POST /api/harness/turn reads a TurnRequest, starts a turn via turnEngine.runTurn(body), and streams turn events.
Turn route streams events as Server-Sent Events: a ReadableStream enqueues encoder.encode(formatSseEvent(event.type,event.data)) for each event in runningTurn.events.
Turn route responds with status 200 and SSE headers: Content-Type text/event-stream; charset=utf-8, Cache-Control no-cache, no-transform, Connection keep-alive.
The turn stream's cancel() callback invokes runningTurn.cancel() to abort the in-flight turn.
The turn stream's start() closes the controller in a finally block, tolerating an already-closed/cancelled stream.

GET /api/project/deliverables normalizes the projectRoot query param via normalizeProjectRoot and scans deliverables via scanProjectDeliverables, returning projectRoot, scannedAt (ISO), and scan results.
On error the deliverables route returns workspaceErrorPayload(error) with its mapped status and body.
dependencies route's requireNonEmptyString throws WorkspaceValidationError('INVALID_REQUEST',400,...) when a field is not a non-empty trimmed string.
normalizeDependencyRows requires rows to be an array; each item must be a non-null non-array object, else WorkspaceValidationError 400.

normalizeDependencyRows produces DependencyRegisterRow objects with a fixed schema (DependencyID, FromPackageID, FromDeliverableID, FromDeliverableName, DependencyClass, AnchorType, Direction, DependencyType, TargetType, Origin, FirstSeen, LastSeen, Status) all defaulting to empty string.
normalizeDependencyRows coerces null/undefined field values to empty string and rejects non-string values with WorkspaceValidationError 400.
GET /api/working-root/deliverable/dependencies reads projectRoot and deliverablePath query params and returns readDeliverableDependencies snapshot.
PUT /api/working-root/deliverable/dependencies validates body projectRoot/deliverablePath, normalizes rows, and persists via writeDeliverableDependencies.
GET /api/working-root/deliverable/status reads projectRoot and deliverablePath query params and returns readDeliverableStatus snapshot.
POST /api/working-root/deliverable/status/transition builds a DeliverableStatusTransitionInput requiring non-empty projectRoot, deliverablePath, targetState, and actor.
Transition input optionally includes trimmed date, parsed metadata, and trimmed approvalSha.
parseMetadata returns undefined for undefined input, rejects non-object/array values, and requires every metadata value to be a string (else WorkspaceValidationError 400).
Transition route applies the change via transitionDeliverableStatus(transitionInput) and returns the result.
GET /api/working-root/scope normalizes projectRoot and scans scopes via scanProjectScopes, returning projectRoot, scannedAt, and scan results.
parseDepth defaults missing/non-finite depth to 3 and clamps provided depth to the integer range [1,6].
GET /api/working-root/tree normalizes projectRoot, parses depth, and returns the tree from readProjectRootTree(projectRoot,depth) with projectRoot, depth, scannedAt, and root.
POST /api/working-root/validate normalizes the body projectRoot via normalizeProjectRoot and returns { ok: true, projectRoot } on success.
globals.css defines the design-token palette on :root: background gradients, panel surfaces, border, text-primary/subtle, accent/accent-soft, assistant/operator surfaces, shadow, and error colors.
globals.css sets color-scheme: light dark on :root, opting the app into both light and dark UA rendering.
RootLayout sets Next.js Metadata title 'Chirality Workflow Shell' and a description naming PORTAL, PIPELINE, and WORKBENCH.
RootLayout (lang='en') wraps children in nested context providers: WorkspaceProvider > DeliverablesProvider > ToolkitProvider.
NotFoundPage renders an AppShell (section PORTAL, 'Route Not Found') with an Unknown Route card and a Link back to PORTAL ('/').
PortalPage renders AppShell (section PORTAL, 'Matrix Navigation') containing the AgentMatrix component.
PipelinePage wraps PipelineClient in a React Suspense boundary with a 'Loading pipeline...' fallback.
PipelineClient defines OperativeCategory union 'DECOMP'|'PREP'|'TASK'|'AUDIT' with CATEGORY_ORDER fixing their order.
SATISFACTION_DISPLAY_ORDER fixes dependency-satisfaction display sequence: TBD, PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SATISFIED, WAIVED, NOT_APPLICABLE.
TRANSITION_ACTOR_OPTIONS enumerates lifecycle actors: WORKING_ITEMS, HUMAN, CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK, 4_DOCUMENTS.
DECOMP_OPTIONS lists SOFTWARE, PROJECT, DOMAIN (enabled) and BASE (disabled, create-new).
PREP_OPTIONS lists PREPARATION, 4_DOCUMENTS, CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK, CHIRALITY_LENS (all enabled).
TASK_AGENT_OPTIONS lists SCOPE_CHANGE/SCOPE_PREP/ESTIMATE_PREP/AUDIT_PREP/SCHEDULE_PREP (enabled) and ESTIMATING/SCHEDULING (disabled).
AUDIT_OPTIONS lists AGENTS, DEPENDENCIES, REFERENCES, SCOPE (enabled) and ESTIMATES, SCHEDULES (disabled).
COORDINATION_MODE_OPTIONS enumerates DEPENDENCY_TRACKED, SCHEDULE_FIRST, HYBRID.
normalizeCategory returns 'DECOMP' fallback for null or unrecognized category values, otherwise echoes the valid OperativeCategory.
renderOptionLabel appends ' (coming soon)' to disabled options' labels.
PipelineClient syncs selectedCategory from the 'category' search param via normalizeCategory on searchParams change.
On projectRoot change PipelineClient resets scaffold state and task-scope selections to defaults.
PipelineClient initializes task scope mode/key/target-deliverable from search params (taskScopeMode, scopeKey, targetDeliverableKey), gated by hasKnowledgeDecomposition.
PipelineClient re-runs sanitizeTaskSelection whenever scope inputs change and writes back any normalized scopeMode/scopeKey/targetDeliverableKey corrections.
knowledgeTargetOptions maps the selected knowledge type's matchingDeliverableKeys to deliverable records via deliverableByKey, filtering out missing ones.
selectedDeliverableKey is the targetDeliverableKey in KNOWLEDGE_TYPES mode and the scopeKey otherwise; its path drives contract loading.
PipelineClient loads deliverable status and dependencies concurrently (Promise.all) when projectRoot and selectedDeliverableScope are set, guarding state updates with a cancelled flag.
When currentLifecycleState changes, PipelineClient defaults transitionTarget to the first allowed next lifecycle target from nextLifecycleTargets.
satisfactionSummary orders dependency satisfaction counts by SATISFACTION_DISPLAY_ORDER first, then appends any remaining keys not already seen.
scaffoldIssuePreview collects up to 5 PREPARATION-compatibility issues (deliverableId + message) from a not-ready scaffold result.
requiresApprovalSha is derived from transitionTarget via requiresApprovalShaForTarget.
When approval-SHA is required, PipelineClient forces transitionActor to 'HUMAN'.
canSubmitTransition requires projectRoot, selectedDeliverableScope, transitionTarget, approvalSha when required, and not submitting/loading.

submitTransition validates inputs, requires approvalSha for CHECKING/ISSUED (error code APPROVAL_SHA_REQUIRED), forces actor HUMAN when SHA required, and applies transitionDeliverableStatus updating statusSnapshot.

submitScaffold requires projectRoot and a non-empty decomposition path, calls scaffoldHarnessExecutionRoot with executionRoot/decompositionPath/optional projectName/coordinationMode, then refreshes scope data and contracts.
requestContractsRefresh clears transition error and increments contractsRefreshToken to re-trigger contract loading.
PIPELINE TASK lane disables KNOWLEDGE_TYPES scope mode when no decomposition marker is detected.
Execution Root Scaffold form runs POST /api/harness/scaffold and validates PREPARATION handoff compatibility.
WorkbenchPage wraps WorkbenchClient in a Suspense boundary with a 'Loading workbench...' fallback.
WorkbenchClient TRANSITION_ACTOR_OPTIONS enumerates WORKING_ITEMS, HUMAN, CHIRALITY_FRAMEWORK, 4_DOCUMENTS.
normalizeAgent returns 'WORKING_ITEMS' for null or blank agent values, otherwise the trimmed agent.
WorkbenchClient reads agent/row/column from search params, defaulting row='NORMATIVE' and column='GUIDING'.
WorkbenchClient fetches deliverable scope from GET /api/working-root/scope?projectRoot=..., parsing a ScopeResponse and defaulting selectedDeliverablePath to the first deliverable.
WorkbenchClient loads status and dependency contracts concurrently via Promise.all when projectRoot and selectedDeliverablePath are set.
transitionEnabled is computed from the agent via canAgentTransitionLifecycle, gating whether lifecycle transitions are permitted.
On lifecycle-state change WorkbenchClient keeps an existing transitionTarget if still valid, otherwise defaults to the first allowed next target.
blockerCandidateIds lists up to 5 DependencyIDs of rows passing isExecutionBlockerSubsetRow.
WorkbenchClient canSubmitTransition additionally requires transitionEnabled (agent permitted) beyond projectRoot/path/target/SHA checks.
WorkbenchClient submitTransition is a no-op when transition is disabled or inputs are missing, and enforces approvalSha for CHECKING/ISSUED transitions.
WORKBENCH renders 'Deliverable Contracts (Read-Only)' and hides the transition form when the agent cannot transition lifecycle.
WORKBENCH preserves chat-driven orchestration while PIPELINE handles spawned task execution; WORKBENCH consumes deliverable contract routes for persona-led checks.
MatrixCell type pairs a row (NORMATIVE|OPERATIVE|EVALUATIVE) and column (GUIDING|APPLYING|JUDGING|REVIEWING) with a label and navigation target.
MATRIX_ROWS defines the 3x4 agent matrix: NORMATIVE row = HELP, ORCHESTRATE, WORKING_ITEMS, AGGREGATE.
MATRIX_ROWS OPERATIVE row = DECOMP*, PREP*, TASK*, AUDIT* targeting /pipeline?category=... lanes.
MATRIX_ROWS EVALUATIVE row = AGENTS, DEPENDENCIES, CHANGE, RECONCILING.
AgentMatrix routes NORMATIVE and EVALUATIVE cells to WORKBENCH and OPERATIVE cells to PIPELINE categories.
AgentMatrix uses a navigation-intent scheduler (createNavigationIntentScheduler) that pushes the target via router.push and is cancelled on unmount.
AgentMatrix lists OPERATIVE deliverable rows from /api/project/deliverables; clicking one opens PIPELINE TASK* with category=TASK, taskScopeMode=DELIVERABLES, and the deliverable key pre-selected.
ApiKeyStatus type carries hasKey, encryptionAvailable, and source ('ui'|'env'|'none').
ChiralityApiKeyBridge exposes store(key), remove(), and status() async methods returning store results / status.
getApiKeyBridge returns window.chirality?.apiKey, or undefined when window is unavailable (non-browser/non-Electron).
ApiKeySettings handleSave errors if the bridge is unavailable ('not running in Electron'), requires a non-empty trimmed key, then stores it and refreshes status.
ApiKeySettings handleRemove calls bridge.remove() and refreshes status, surfacing failures as errors.
ApiKeySettings sourceLabel reflects key source: 'ui' = stored in secure storage, 'env' = from environment variable, otherwise 'No API key configured'.
ApiKeySettings warns when encryption is unavailable, instructing use of the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
ApiKeySettings shows the key input only when the bridge is available and encryption is not explicitly unavailable; otherwise shows an out-of-Electron hint.
The API key input uses placeholder 'sk-ant-...' and disables autocomplete/autocorrect/autocapitalize/spellcheck plus password-manager ignore attributes.
ShellSection type is 'PORTAL'|'PIPELINE'|'WORKBENCH'; AppShellProps takes section, title, subtitle, and children.
NAVIGATION_ITEMS maps '/' to PORTAL, '/pipeline' to PIPELINE, '/workbench' to WORKBENCH.
PANE_TITLE maps resizable pane keys fileTree/toolkit/chat to display titles; DRAG_DIRECTION sets fileTree=+1 and toolkit/chat=-1 for resize sign.
AppShell initializes layout state via createDefaultLayoutState and tracks layoutWidth, resizingPane, and a dragStateRef for pane resizing.
AppShell reads layout state from window.localStorage on mount and persists layoutState back to localStorage on change (SSR-guarded by window checks).
AppShell observes the layout element with a ResizeObserver to keep layoutWidth current, re-subscribing when toolkit visibility changes.
AppShell exposes pane widths to CSS as custom properties --pane-file-tree-width/--pane-toolkit-width/--pane-chat-width via resolvePaneWidth.
resizePaneByDelta adjusts a pane width by a delta, clamps via clampPaneWidthForLayout, and un-collapses that pane.
togglePaneCollapse flips the collapsed flag for a pane.
handleResizePointerDown ignores non-primary buttons, records drag start X and start width, and sets the active resizing pane.
During resize AppShell listens on window for pointermove/pointerup/pointercancel; pointermove applies a direction-scaled delta with clamping, and pointerup/cancel stop resizing.
handleResizeKeyDown supports keyboard pane resize: ArrowRight/Left adjust width by 16px (40px with Shift), Home collapses the pane, End expands to a clamped width.
renderResizeHandle renders a role=separator handle with aria-orientation vertical, aria-valuemin/now, tabIndex 0, and pointer/keydown resize handlers.
applyDraftPath clears the project root when the draft is blank, otherwise applies the trimmed path via applyProjectRoot.
AppShell header renders the app icon, section kicker, title, subtitle, optional update banner, and primary navigation links with active-state styling.
AppShell working-root bar provides a path input (Apply Path), Choose Folder (styled muted when no Electron picker), Clear, a toolkit-sidebar checkbox, and the ApiKeySettings panel.
AppShell renders a resizable grid of File Tree, main Execution Surface, optional Tool Kit (when toolkit visible), and Chat panes, each collapsible.
AppShell wraps ChatPanel in a Suspense boundary with a chat-panel loading fallback.
extractLanguage returns '' unless className starts with 'language-', then returns the lowercased trimmed language token.
trimTrailingFenceNewline strips a single trailing newline from a code fence value.
MARKDOWN_COMPONENTS renders anchors with target=_blank and rel='noreferrer noopener'.
MARKDOWN_COMPONENTS code renderer detects inline vs block, extracts language, and uses an ANSI fallback when language is 'ansi' or the text contains ANSI escape codes.
ANSI code blocks render via dangerouslySetInnerHTML using renderAnsiToHtml(rawText) inside a chat-code-block--ansi pre.
ChatMarkdown renders source with ReactMarkdown using remarkGfm and the custom MARKDOWN_COMPONENTS.
import statements and module boilerplate.
'use client' directive and React/Next import boilerplate.
globals.css concrete style rules (layout, spacing, component class styling) beyond the design-token palette.
Notes: Presentational CSS; not a substantive domain fact
